title: Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business
claims_supported: Minimize sensitive information, retain only for a business or legal need, use a written retention policy and dispose securely
material_limitations: General business guidance; not a self-storage retention schedule, legal opinion, universal duration or proof of compliance

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: NIST Privacy Framework Version 1.0
claims_supported: Treat retention, transformation, sharing and disposal as connected data-lifecycle actions
material_limitations: Voluntary and nonbinding; not a sector-specific schedule, law, certification or operational implementation
provenance: Official NIST landing page and version record

title: Preparing Disposition Instructions
claims_supported: Define a precise cutoff or trigger and explicit disposition instruction instead of vague when-no-longer-needed language
material_limitations: Governs federal records processes and is used only as a design example; it does not apply its example periods to a private self-storage operator

organization: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
title: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure
claims_supported: Rule 37 establishes a federal-civil-litigation preservation boundary for electronically stored information
material_limitations: Applicability and preservation duties require qualified legal advice; the article does not interpret a specific dispute, jurisdiction or record class

organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: SP 800-88 Rev. 2, Guidelines for Media Sanitization
claims_supported: Treat sanitization as a governed program with methods and controls matched to information sensitivity and verify the outcome
material_limitations: Focused on media sanitization; not a self-storage retention schedule, software-provider deletion guarantee, legal opinion or certification
provenance: Official NIST CSRC final publication record
